## Core Technical Focus & Engineering Hierarchy
1. **Core Pillar — Robotics & Autonomous Systems**:
   - Flagship Project: **ARES (Autonomous Rescue & Emergency System)** — Four-wheel-drive autonomous ground vehicle for GPS-denied disaster reconnaissance. Features 360° LiDAR spatial SLAM mapping, IMU Extended Kalman Filtering, edge computer vision (YOLO/OpenCV) for thermal/survivor tagging, deterministic FreeRTOS C++ control, and AES-256-GCM encrypted RF/MQTT mesh telemetry.
   - Autonomous Rover Platform: STM32/Arduino with closed-loop PID trajectory control and ultrasonic obstacle avoidance.
   - Cyber-Physical Encrypted Telemetry Node: Low-power ESP32, FreeRTOS, MQTT over TLS, AES-GCM payload encryption.
2. **Secondary Pillar — AI, Computer Vision & Enterprise Software**:
   - VisionAI Edge Pipeline: Real-time object classification and anomaly detection at 60 FPS using PyTorch, OpenCV, YOLO, and ONNX Runtime.
   - Enterprise Distributed Cloud Backend: High-concurrency architectures built with Django (Python), Node.js, C#/.NET, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker.
3. **Differentiator — Cybersecurity & Secure Systems**:
   - Secure Vault (iOS): Zero-knowledge AES-256-GCM password manager built with SwiftUI, Apple CryptoKit, and Secure Enclave Face ID authentication.
   - PenTest Hub: Python vulnerability scanner automating OWASP Top 10 auditing with Burp Suite API & AsyncIO.
   - Secure Chat (E2EE): End-to-end encrypted mobile messaging engine with Diffie-Hellman ephemeral key exchange.
4. **Research Track — Quantum Communications & Cryptography**:
   - Graduation Thesis: *Simulation and Security Analysis of Quantum Key Distribution (QKD) Protocols* (University of Babylon, 2025–2026). Mathematical modeling and computational verification of BB84, Decoy-State QKD, QBER distillation, and photon-number-splitting (PNS) attack analysis via Qiskit.
